title: rosa glauca subsp. pseudomarsica
intro: Rosa glauca subsp. pseudomarsica, commonly known as a subspecies of the Rosa glauca plant, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa glauca subsp. pseudomarsica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are thought to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
